Inside was a slip of paper, soft from damp, the ink half surrendered to the sea. He carried it up the spiral stairs and smoothed it under the lamp. A child's hand had written only a name and a single line: tell them I am safe. He read it three times, then looked out at the grey water that had carried it across who knew how many miles. He folded the note, set it on the sill, and lit the lamp early that night.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯还亮着，光晕落在空荡的马路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下短促的声响。便利店的玻璃后，店员靠着柜台打盹，热饮在机器里缓缓转动。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，节奏均匀。天边泛出一线灰蓝，楼宇的轮廓渐渐清晰。有人刚下夜班，有人准备早起，城市在这一刻交接着昼与夜，安静得像在默默呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller copy of itself.\n- It keeps going to smaller versions until it reaches a tiny case so simple the answer is obvious.\n- Like standing between two mirrors: each reflection holds a smaller one inside it, all the way down."}
